en: {player} found the Sapphire! It shone a deep, clear blue.
Ha! I knew it. I was right to follow you down here!
I've been looking for this gem for years. I'll take that, thank you!
Team Rocket will pay a fortune for a stone like this. All I have to do is take it to their warehouse on Five Island.
The password for the inner door? 'Ekans ate the cake.' Ha! As if you could ever get that far. So long!
